SELECT SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.ROW_NUM , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.ATTACH_NO , SETL.SUBJECT , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS CHAR(4000)) AS REMARK , CAST(SETL.REJECT_REMARK AS CHAR(4000)) AS REJECT_REMARK , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , CAST(SETL.SUBMIT_REMARK AS CHAR(4000)) AS SUBMIT_REMARK , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID , SETL.EXT_USE_PLACE , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_MINUTE , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_MINUTE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS EXT_USE_DEPT_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as EXT_USE_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) as CONFIRM_USER_NAME_LOC FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SDEPT ADD_USER_DEPT ON ADD_USER_DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND ADD_USER_DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND ADD_USER_DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = $S{SMR_NUMBER} AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = $S{REQ_USER_ID} AND IFNULL(SETL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND SETL.APPLY_TYPE = 'CEXT'
AND ( SETL.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID} OR ( ADD_USER_DEPT.DEPT = ${session.DEPARTMENT} AND SETL.SMR_STATUS != 'T' ) )
AND SETL.SMR_STATUS IN($INS{SMR_STATUS}) AND (SETL.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.ADD_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SMR_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') ) AND SETL.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SETL.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ORDER BY SETL.SMR_NUMBER DESC

UPDATE SSETL SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , DEL_FLAG = IFNULL(${DEL_FLAG } , DEL_FLAG ) , SMR_STATUS = IFNULL(${SMR_STATUS } , SMR_STATUS ) , SEAL_USE_TYPE = IFNULL(${SEAL_USE_TYPE } , SEAL_USE_TYPE ) , SUBJECT = IFNULL(${SUBJECT } , SUBJECT ) , REMARK = IFNULL(${REMARK } , REMARK ) , REJECT_REMARK = IFNULL(${REJECT_REMARK } , REJECT_REMARK ) , SUBMISSION_PLACE = IFNULL(${SUBMISSION_PLACE} , SUBMISSION_PLACE) , EXT_USE_PLACE = IFNULL(${EXT_USE_PLACE } , EXT_USE_PLACE ) , EXT_USE_USER_ID = IFNULL(${EXT_USE_USER_ID } , EXT_USE_USER_ID ) , ATTACH_NO = IFNULL(${ATTACH_NO } , ATTACH_NO ) , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE = IFNULL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE } , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE ) , EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME = SUBSTR(CONCAT(IFNULL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), IFNULL(${EXT_OUT_EXPECT_MINUTE}, ''), '000000'),1,6) , EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE = IFNULL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE } , EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE ) , EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME = SUBSTR(CONCAT(IFNULL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR}, ''), IFNULL(${EXT_IN_EXPECT_MINUTE}, ''), '000000') ,1,6) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER}

SELECT SEDC.HOUSE_CODE , SEDC.COMPANY_CODE , SEDC.SMR_NUMBER , SEDC.SMR_SEQ , SEDC.ADD_DATE , SEDC.ADD_TIME , SEDC.ADD_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SEDC.HOUSE_CODE, SEDC.COMPANY_CODE, SEDC.ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME , SEDC.SUBJECT , SEDC.COUNT , SEDC.ATTACH_NO , SEDC.SMD_NUMBER , SEDC.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , SEDC.SEAL_MG_SUBJECT FROM SSEDC SEDC WHERE SEDC.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEDC.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEDC.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND IFNULL(SEDC.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SEDC.SMR_SEQ ASC, SEDC.SMD_NUMBER ASC

SELECT SETL.HOUSE_CODE , SETL.COMPANY_CODE , SETL.ROW_NUM , SETL.SMR_NUMBER , SETL.SMR_STATUS , SETL.ADD_DATE , SETL.ADD_TIME , SETL.ADD_USER_ID , SETL.CHANGE_DATE , SETL.CHANGE_TIME , SETL.CHANGE_USER_ID , SETL.DEL_FLAG , SETL.SEAL_USE_TYPE , SETL.APPLY_TYPE , SETL.SUBJECT , CAST(SETL.REMARK AS CHAR(4000)) AS REMARK , SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE , SETL.CONFIRM_DATE , SETL.CONFIRM_TIME , SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID , SETL.SUBMIT_TYPE , SETL.EXT_OUT_DATE , SETL.EXT_OUT_TIME , SETL.EXT_IN_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_TIME , SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_DATE , SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_DATE , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_OUT_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_OUT_EXPECT_MINUTE , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,1,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_HOUR , SUBSTR(SETL.EXT_IN_EXPECT_TIME,3,2) AS EXT_IN_EXPECT_MINUTE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS DEPT_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.ADD_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ADD_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS USE_USER_NAME_LOC , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SETL.HOUSE_CODE, SETL.COMPANY_CODE, SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS CONFIRM_USER_NAME_LOC FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT ADD_USMT ON ADD_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND ADD_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND ADD_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.ADD_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USE_USMT ON USE_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND USE_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND USE_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.EXT_USE_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT CONFIRM_USMT ON CONFIRM_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SETL.HOUSE_CODE AND CONFIRM_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SETL.COMPANY_CODE AND CONFIRM_USMT.USER_ID = SETL.CONFIRM_USER_ID WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = $S{SMR_NUMBER} AND SETL.ADD_USER_ID = $S{REQ_USER_ID} AND IFNULL(SETL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND SETL.APPLY_TYPE = 'CEXT'
AND ( SETL.ADD_USER_ID = ${session.ID} OR ADD_USMT.DEPT = ${session.DEPARTMENT} )
AND SETL.SMR_STATUS IN($INS{SMR_STATUS}) AND (SETL.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.ADD_USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SMR_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR SETL.SUBMISSION_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR ADD_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR USE_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR CONFIRM_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%')) AND SETL.ADD_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SETL.ADD_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ORDER BY SETL.SMR_NUMBER DESC
